node.label: Society & Social Justice
node.summary: Labour rights, women and children, minorities, accidents and safety.

facts.text: On the Danger-in-the-sewer editorial: **859** sanitation workers died on sewer/septic-tank jobs (2014-2025), **332** across 18 States/UTs (2021-26); SC's *Dr. Balram Singh* (2023) raised death compensation to **₹30 lakh** per worker.
facts.plain: On the Danger-in-the-sewer editorial: 859 sanitation workers died on sewer/septic-tank jobs (2014-2025), 332 across 18 States/UTs (2021-26); SC's Dr. Balram Singh (2023) raised death compensation to ₹30 lakh per worker.

facts.text: A 3-storey **unauthorised** building under construction collapsed in old Delhi's **Chawri Bazar**, killing 2 and trapping others; Delhi Police had flagged the illegal construction as early as **15 June**; it is Delhi's **3rd major building collapse since 6 September**, after 13 deaths.
facts.plain: A 3-storey unauthorised building under construction collapsed in old Delhi's Chawri Bazar, killing 2 and trapping others; Delhi Police had flagged the illegal construction as early as 15 June; it is Delhi's 3rd major building collapse since 6 September, after 13 deaths.

facts.text: An Indian was killed when two helicopters (Fishtail Air, Air Dynasty) collided near **Everest Base Camp**, Nepal.
facts.plain: An Indian was killed when two helicopters (Fishtail Air, Air Dynasty) collided near Everest Base Camp, Nepal.

facts.text: **Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana** (Maharashtra, 2024) gives monthly aid to women aged **21-65** from low-income families.
facts.plain: Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana (Maharashtra, 2024) gives monthly aid to women aged 21-65 from low-income families.

facts.text: Women protested in Mumbai over pending instalments of Maharashtra's **Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana** (₹1,500 a month; ₹2,100 had been promised), led by **AIDWA**.
facts.plain: Women protested in Mumbai over pending instalments of Maharashtra's Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana (₹1,500 a month; ₹2,100 had been promised), led by AIDWA.

facts.text: Fire at the **HPCL Visakh Refinery** (Residue Upgradation Facility), Visakhapatnam; no casualties.
facts.plain: Fire at the HPCL Visakh Refinery (Residue Upgradation Facility), Visakhapatnam; no casualties.

facts.text: **India Hate Lab** recorded 60 attacks on Christians in West Bengal (13 May to 20 Sept); a People's Tribunal heard survivors.
facts.plain: India Hate Lab recorded 60 attacks on Christians in West Bengal (13 May to 20 Sept); a People's Tribunal heard survivors.

facts.text: POCSO: Kasaragod paediatrician **Dr P. Krishnan** (78) was sentenced to 47 years, running concurrently as **20 years**, for sexually assaulting a 15-year-old patient.
facts.plain: POCSO: Kasaragod paediatrician Dr P. Krishnan (78) was sentenced to 47 years, running concurrently as 20 years, for sexually assaulting a 15-year-old patient.

facts.text: Law: **Bonded Labour System (Abolition) Act, 1976**. **Art. 23** bans forced labour.
facts.plain: Law: Bonded Labour System (Abolition) Act, 1976. Art. 23 bans forced labour.

facts.text: The Court called identification, release and rehabilitation a 'continuing constitutional obligation'.
facts.plain: The Court called identification, release and rehabilitation a 'continuing constitutional obligation'.

facts.text: SC (Justices **Vikram Nath** and **Aparesh Kumar Singh**): aid to freed bonded labourers within **7 days**; verify complaints in 24 hours; release certificate in 24 hours; States to adopt the SOP within 6 months.
facts.plain: SC (Justices Vikram Nath and Aparesh Kumar Singh): aid to freed bonded labourers within 7 days; verify complaints in 24 hours; release certificate in 24 hours; States to adopt the SOP within 6 months.

facts.text: About 4,000 women students at Aligarh Muslim University's Women's College were denied voting rights in the AMU Students' Union elections (scheduled 5 Nov, the first in 8 years), reviving a gender-representation debate that traces back to a 2012 committee formed under the Lyngdoh Committee framework.
facts.plain: About 4,000 women students at Aligarh Muslim University's Women's College were denied voting rights in the AMU Students' Union elections (scheduled 5 Nov, the first in 8 years), reviving a gender-representation debate that traces back to a 2012 committee formed under the Lyngdoh Committee framework.

facts.text: Jadavpur University ordered a probe after a first-year Arts student alleged molestation by a non-teaching staffer on campus; Vice-Chancellor Chiranjib Bhattacharjee ordered the inquiry.
facts.plain: Jadavpur University ordered a probe after a first-year Arts student alleged molestation by a non-teaching staffer on campus; Vice-Chancellor Chiranjib Bhattacharjee ordered the inquiry.

facts.text: A Sub-Inspector and a constable were arrested (taking the total to three arrests) over an alleged rape inside a police station in **Seraikela, Jharkhand**; a Special Investigation Team was formed under SP Manoj Swargiary.
facts.plain: A Sub-Inspector and a constable were arrested (taking the total to three arrests) over an alleged rape inside a police station in Seraikela, Jharkhand; a Special Investigation Team was formed under SP Manoj Swargiary.

facts.text: A four-year-old boy died in a stray dog attack in **Kalaburagi** (Karnataka); a case was filed against the city corporation.
facts.plain: A four-year-old boy died in a stray dog attack in Kalaburagi (Karnataka); a case was filed against the city corporation.

facts.text: Two foreign nationals (a German Lufthansa crew member and a Slovak) died of suspected electrocution in the pool of the **Conrad Hotel**, Bengaluru; police booked the hotel management for negligence.
facts.plain: Two foreign nationals (a German Lufthansa crew member and a Slovak) died of suspected electrocution in the pool of the Conrad Hotel, Bengaluru; police booked the hotel management for negligence.

facts.text: Profile of **Hechin Haokip**, founder of the Centre for Women and Girls (CWG), a 20-year-old organisation in Manipur's Kuki-dominated hill districts (Chandel, Tengnoupal) working on gender equity, child rights and peace-building amid the Meitei-Kuki conflict.
facts.plain: Profile of Hechin Haokip, founder of the Centre for Women and Girls (CWG), a 20-year-old organisation in Manipur's Kuki-dominated hill districts (Chandel, Tengnoupal) working on gender equity, child rights and peace-building amid the Meitei-Kuki conflict.

facts.text: **Section 69** of the **Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita** separately punishes sexual intercourse obtained by deceitful means, such as a false promise of marriage, with up to **10 years** in jail.
facts.plain: Section 69 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita separately punishes sexual intercourse obtained by deceitful means, such as a false promise of marriage, with up to 10 years in jail.

facts.text: SC (Justice **B.V. Nagarathna**) held that a consensual relationship that later sours cannot be turned into a **rape** charge; rape must be reserved for real violence, coercion or manipulated consent (case from Keralam).
facts.plain: SC (Justice B.V. Nagarathna) held that a consensual relationship that later sours cannot be turned into a rape charge; rape must be reserved for real violence, coercion or manipulated consent (case from Keralam).

facts.text: Delhi: a magisterial probe was ordered into the **7 Oct Seemapuri** building collapse (5 dead); a fire at a shoe factory in **Mangolpuri** Industrial Area killed four.
facts.plain: Delhi: a magisterial probe was ordered into the 7 Oct Seemapuri building collapse (5 dead); a fire at a shoe factory in Mangolpuri Industrial Area killed four.

facts.text: 19 children (five below 14) were rescued from garment and jewellery units in east Delhi's **Gandhi Nagar**, paid as little as ₹10 a day.
facts.plain: 19 children (five below 14) were rescued from garment and jewellery units in east Delhi's Gandhi Nagar, paid as little as ₹10 a day.

facts.text: Under the **Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006**, the minimum age is **18 for women and 21 for men**. Child labour below **14** is banned under the Child Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Act, 1986 (amended 2016).
facts.plain: Under the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006, the minimum age is 18 for women and 21 for men. Child labour below 14 is banned under the Child Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Act, 1986 (amended 2016).

facts.text: Assam CM **Himanta Biswa Sarma** said 560+ people were arrested in a new crackdown on **child marriage**; the State claims an 81% drop in child marriages across 20 districts.
facts.plain: Assam CM Himanta Biswa Sarma said 560+ people were arrested in a new crackdown on child marriage; the State claims an 81% drop in child marriages across 20 districts.

facts.text: Niyamgiri (2013): in *Orissa Mining Corporation v. MoEF*, the SC let gram sabhas decide under the **Forest Rights Act, 2006**; all 12 rejected the mine. India has **75 PVTGs**, the most in Odisha.
facts.plain: Niyamgiri (2013): in Orissa Mining Corporation v. MoEF, the SC let gram sabhas decide under the Forest Rights Act, 2006; all 12 rejected the mine. India has 75 PVTGs, the most in Odisha.

facts.text: Odisha bauxite deposits: **Panchpatmali** (NALCO, 310 MT, Koraput); **Sijimali** (Vedanta, 311 MT, got environmental clearance); **Karlapat** (248 MT, Vedanta preferred bidder); **Kutrumali** (Adani, 127.7 MT); **Baphlimali** (Aditya Birla, 197 MT); **Kodingamali** (OMC). Odisha CM: **Mohan Charan Majhi**.
facts.plain: Odisha bauxite deposits: Panchpatmali (NALCO, 310 MT, Koraput); Sijimali (Vedanta, 311 MT, got environmental clearance); Karlapat (248 MT, Vedanta preferred bidder); Kutrumali (Adani, 127.7 MT); Baphlimali (Aditya Birla, 197 MT); Kodingamali (OMC). Odisha CM: Mohan Charan Majhi.

facts.text: **Dongria Kondh** (a PVTG) villagers marched against renewed mining attempts in the **Niyamgiri** hills, where gram sabhas rejected Vedanta's bauxite mine under SC supervision 13 years ago. OMC-Vedanta signed the original deal in **2003**.
facts.plain: Dongria Kondh (a PVTG) villagers marched against renewed mining attempts in the Niyamgiri hills, where gram sabhas rejected Vedanta's bauxite mine under SC supervision 13 years ago. OMC-Vedanta signed the original deal in 2003.

facts.text: Odisha bauxite belt: **Kalahandi, Rayagada and Koraput** hold **51%** of India's bauxite reserves but give **74.64%** of production (Indian Minerals Yearbook 2023). Activists, including Dr **Randall Sequeira**, have been jailed under the 'unnamed others' category of FIRs; PUDR counts 43 cases and 100+ Adivasis and Dalits jailed in three years.
